extDescription.message: Your LinkedIn feed without strangers, fluff or vanity numbers. Runs 100% in your browser.

statCaption.message: posts kept out of your way today

featMetricsDesc.message: Hides likes, views and follower counts

popupPausedHint.message: Sereno is paused. LinkedIn looks as usual.

secPeopleDesc.message: Hover over a post and use the Sereno button to mute someone or to never hide them.

caughtBodyOld.message: You've seen what's new from your network. What follows, you've already seen.

featCaughtDesc.message: Tells you when you've seen what's new

secCaughtDesc.message: Breaks the infinite scroll: tells you when you start seeing posts you have already seen, or after a number of posts in one visit.

caughtNote.message: To know what you have seen, Sereno stores an anonymous fingerprint of each post (not its content) in your browser for 21 days.

welcomeBody.message: Open your LinkedIn feed and you will notice the difference. It comes with sensible defaults; tune it to your liking here.

secNetworkDesc.message: See the people you actually know again.

optHideActivityDesc.message: Posts that show up because someone liked, commented on or reposted them.

optOnlyDirectDesc.message: Also hides posts from 2nd and 3rd degree. If the degree is unclear, the post is shown.

secSmokeDesc.message: Looks for signs of content made to hook, not to help. Simple rules that run in your browser, without sending anything to any AI.

smokeDesc_bait.message: “Comment YES and I’ll DM you the PDF”, “Repost ♻️”, “Agree?”

smokeDesc_hook.message: “5 years ago I got fired…”, “Unpopular opinion”, “Read that again”

smokeDesc_format.message: One sentence per line and a waterfall of emoji bullets

smokeDesc_manual.message: “Game changer”, “in today’s fast-paced world”, “it’s not about X, it’s about Y”

secMetricsDesc.message: Read the content, not the scoreboard.

optMetrics.message: Hide likes, comments, views and follower counts

secMutedDesc.message: Hide posts that mention these words or phrases.

mutedPlaceholder.message: Type a word and press Enter

optPlaceholders.message: Leave a note where something was hidden

optPlaceholdersDesc.message: A discreet line with the reason and a button to show it anyway.

privacyBody.message: Sereno runs 100% in your browser. It has no servers, no analytics and sends nothing anywhere. In your browser it only stores your settings, the people you muted or protected, a count of hidden posts and anonymous fingerprints of what you have seen.

aboutBody.message: Sereno is an independent project. It is not affiliated with, endorsed or sponsored by LinkedIn Corporation. LinkedIn is a registered trademark of LinkedIn Corporation.

aboutAds.message: Sereno does not hide or alter ads.

resetConfirm.message: Go back to the original settings?
